Definition: Anah, the name of two Edomites and one Edomitess
BiblicalUsage: Anah = "answer"; n pr m; 1) son of Zibeon and father of Aholibamah, a wife of Esau; 2) a Horite chief; n pr f; 3) daughter of Zibeon
